description: B9P7施工责任修订。将B10-B154中可能创建第二系统的步骤修订为复用/扩展Canonical系统。每个修订包含原责任、修订后责任、原因和移除的重复系统风险。

revisionPolicy.B10-B18: Gap审计为主，只补真实缺失字段，不创建新Registry/Broker/Pipeline/Facade
revisionPolicy.B19-B22: ADAPTER_ONLY，在现有RuntimeAdapter合同上新增平台适配器
revisionPolicy.B23-B54: MIGRATION_ONLY + EXTEND，迁移到现有Canonical系统，做Gap Hardening而非新建
revisionPolicy.B79-B86: NEW_PROVIDER，Browser/Search Provider空白领域，实现RuntimeAdapter接口
revisionPolicy.B133-B139: INTEGRATION_ONLY，各模块已完成，只接线注册

corrections.oldResponsibility: 构建Tool共享合同(可能涉及新建ToolRuntimeContract系统)
corrections.newResponsibility: 基于B9P4冻结的Capability/Tool映射，对现有ToolDefinition/CapabilityDefinition/ToolInvocationContext/UnifiedToolResult进行Gap审计，只补真实缺失合同字段，注册到capability.ToolRegistry
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Tool合同(Capability.ToolRegistry + ToolDefinition + ToolFacade)，不得新建

corrections.oldResponsibility: 构建权限合同(可能涉及新建PermissionRegistry/PermissionEngine)
corrections.newResponsibility: 基于B9P4确定的14个Permission GAP，在现有permission.PermissionDefinitionRegistry上扩展缺失Permission定义(security.permission.manage, browser.automation, device.access等)，注册到permission.PermissionBroker
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical PermissionBroker + PermissionDefinition，不得新建第二Permission系统

corrections.oldResponsibility: 构建运行时合同(可能涉及新建RuntimeSupervisor/AgentRuntime)
corrections.newResponsibility: 基于B9P6确认的RuntimeAdapter/RuntimeBinding合同，对现有Runtime Adapter(RuntimeAdapterRegistry)进行Gap审计，补全缺失RuntimeBinding变体，复用runtimeorchestrator.Host
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical RuntimeOrchestrator + RuntimeAdapterRegistry，不得新建第二Runtime

corrections.newResponsibility: 审计现有resourceuri包，确认是否满足Parity所有URI schema需求，只补缺失URI类型，复用WorkspaceProvider
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical ResourceURI系统，不得新建替代URI方案

corrections.newResponsibility: 在RuntimeAdapterRegistry中新增BrowserProvider实现，Playwright/CDP引擎作为Provider后端，不创建独立BrowserRuntime系统

corrections.oldResponsibility: 构建Media/Device Provider(可能创建独立MediaEngine)
corrections.newResponsibility: 在RuntimeAdapterRegistry中扩展MediaProvider，Device能力注册为Capability+PlatformAdapter，不创建独立MediaRuntime
映射到现有Canonical系统: Voice→tts/ASR, Model→chat/model_service, Automation→extension/kernel/workflow，只补缺失映射关系
corrections.reason: 已有各领域的Canonical系统，只需映射不新建

corrections.oldResponsibility: Extension Manifest补强(可能创建新Manifest格式/Registry)
corrections.newResponsibility: 在现有Extension Manifest结构上补强缺失字段，注册到Canonical Extension Registry，不创建新Manifest路由

corrections.oldResponsibility: Extension Kernel唯一性验证(可能建立第二个验证通道)
corrections.newResponsibility: 对Extension Kernel做唯一性静态扫描，确认ToolFacade为唯一ModelTool入口、ToolRegistry为唯一注册中心、ExecutionPipeline为唯一执行器、PermissionBroker为唯一决策中心。扫描结果注册为B140前置PASS证据
corrections.reason: B9P6已确认唯一性，本步骤只做确认验证

corrections.oldResponsibility: Android Capability Adapter(可能创建AndroidRuntime替代Extension Kernel)
corrections.newResponsibility: 新增Android Capability Adapter实现，通过RuntimeAdapter接口注册到Kernel，所有Permission通过PermissionBroker决策，所有Execution通过ExecutionPipeline
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Kernel合同，Android只是平台适配器

corrections.oldResponsibility: iOS Capability Adapter(可能创建iOSRuntime替代Extension Kernel)
corrections.newResponsibility: 新增iOS Capability Adapter实现，通过RuntimeAdapter接口注册到Kernel，Health/Calendar/Reminders/Contacts通过PlatformAdapter暴露
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Kernel合同，iOS只是平台适配器

corrections.oldResponsibility: Desktop Adapter(可能创建DesktopRuntime替代Extension Kernel)
corrections.newResponsibility: 新增Desktop Capability Adapter实现，通过RuntimeAdapter接口注册到Kernel，Browser/Search/File能力由DesktopProvider暴露
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Kernel合同，Desktop只是平台适配器

corrections.oldResponsibility: 三端Adapter统一验证(可能创建第三个验证通道)
corrections.newResponsibility: 验证Android/iOS/Desktop三个Adapter全部通过RuntimeAdapterRegistry注册、全部通过PermissionBroker决策、全部通过ExecutionPipeline执行。输出三端一致证报告
corrections.reason: 统一验证通道，不创建替代验证系统

corrections.newResponsibility: 将Planner能力迁移到mindruntime/decision/，复用现有MindRuntime架构，Planner产生的决策通过ToolRegistry注册为Tool，ExecutionPipeline执行
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical MindRuntime(decision)系统，Planner只是其能力扩展

corrections.newResponsibility: 将Observer/Reflection能力迁移到mindruntime/，复用MindRuntime的认知循环，Observer输出通过EventSystem发布，Reflection结果存储到Memory
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical MindRuntime，Observer/Reflection只是认知层能力

corrections.newResponsibility: 复用extension/kernel/workflow/ 作为TaskGraph引擎，TaskGraph定义注册到WorkflowRegistry，执行由WorkflowExecutor驱动，GraphNode映射为WorkflowStep
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Workflow系统，TaskGraph是Workflow的一种编排模式

corrections.oldResponsibility: 新建BackgroundTaskRuntime(独立后台任务系统)
corrections.newResponsibility: 复用extension/kernel/task_runtime/ 作为BackgroundTask引擎，长任务注册到TaskRuntime.Queue，通过TaskRuntime的Timeout/Recovery/Cancel语义管理
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical TaskRuntime系统，BackgroundTask是其标准用例

corrections.newResponsibility: 统一关联到pipelinecheckpoint/workflow/checkpoint。ExecutionPipeline的Checkpoint写入WorkflowCheckpointStore，TaskRuntime的Recovery读取同一Store
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Checkpoint路径(pipelinecheckpoint/workflow)，不允许创建第二Checkpoint事实源

corrections.newResponsibility: 新建Multi-Agent Coordinator模块，但必须复用现有ToolRegistry注册Coordinator Tool、复用TaskRuntime管理Coordinator Task、复用Workflow驱动Coordinator编排。Coordinator不作为独立Runtime
corrections.reason: Multi-Agent是新能力但基础Runtime已有Canonical系统，只新增Coordinator逻辑层

corrections.newResponsibility: 复用backend/internal/memory/作为Memory能力存储层，Memory操作注册为Tool到ToolRegistry，Memory检索通过Capability暴露
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Memory系统，只需扩展Parity缺失能力

corrections.newResponsibility: 将Decision能力迁移到mindruntime/decision/，Decision Tool注册到ToolRegistry，Decision结果通过EventSystem广播
将Planning能力迁移到mindruntime/planner/，Planning Tool注册到ToolRegistry，Planning输出驱动Workflow
复用extension/kernel/execution/pipeline.go作为执行引擎，Execution能力扩展ExecutionPipeline，不创建独立ExecutionRuntime
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical ExecutionPipeline，Execution只是其能力声明

corrections.newResponsibility: 将Tool能力迁移到extension/kernel/capability/，Tool注册到capability.ToolRegistry，Tool分发通过RuntimeAdapterRegistry路由
将Skill能力迁移到extension/kernel/agent_skill/，Skill注册到AgentSkillCatalog，Skill prompt注入到ChatExtensionRegistry
复用Canonical Memory + Embedding + VectorStore作为Knowledge后端，Knowledge能力注册为Tool到ToolRegistry，知识检索通过Capability暴露
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Memory/Embedding系统，Knowledge是组合能力

corrections.newResponsibility: 将Character能力迁移到backend/internal/character/，Character注册到CharacterSystem，角色对话通过ChatExtensionRegistry接入
复用现有EventSystem + Workflow + ToolRegistry作为Collaboration后端，Collaboration Tool注册到ToolRegistry，协作编排通过Workflow驱动

corrections.oldResponsibility: 新建AutomationRuntime(独立自动化运行时)
corrections.newResponsibility: 复用extension/kernel/workflow/ + schedule/作为Automation后端，Automation注册到ScheduleRegistry，自动化触发通过Workflow执行
在现有Canonical ToolRegistry/ExecutionPipeline/PermissionBroker基础上做Gap审计，补全缺失的502 Capability→Tool映射，只补Gap不创建替代系统
corrections.reason: 所有Agent能力已迁移至Canonical系统，Gap Hardening是在现有系统上补洞

corrections.newResponsibility: 在现有permission.PermissionBroker/PermissionDefinitionRegistry上扩展Governance语义，Governance规则注册为Permission定义
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical Permission系统，Governance是其规则扩展

corrections.newResponsibility: 在现有EventSystem基础上扩展Audit事件类型，AuditTrail通过EventSubscriptionRegistry订阅，Audit日志持久化到现有Store
corrections.reason: 已有Canonical EventSystem，Audit是事件消费模式

corrections.newResponsibility: 在B9P5基础上确认现有Error Projection/State Projection满足Parity需求，只补缺失Projection规则，不创建新Error系统

corrections.oldResponsibility: Capability ID规范(可能重建ID命名空间)

corrections.oldResponsibility: B140静态前置PASS(可能创建第三个前置通道)
